title: Sensing chemistry with light
lead: ArtiSense is a proposed compact photonic system for chemical sensing.
description: Its intended path is to illuminate a sample, observe its optical response and interpret the signal. The proposed architecture also considers analog signal processing.

sections.title: The intended system
paragraphs: Optical components, electronics, reference comparison and interpretation would need to operate together. The described architecture is a research direction, not a finished wearable device.

sections.title: Current evidence
paragraphs: Supplied research discusses optical feasibility and glucose chip design. It does not establish a fabricated device, clinical accuracy or non-invasive performance.

sections.title: What comes next
paragraphs: A meaningful next step is to test components and calibration assumptions under controlled conditions, then assess integration and intended-use requirements.
